component.name: ANOTHERpass
component.summary: Offline password manager with generated master passwords

description.p: ANOTHERpass is an offline password manager. Instead of asking you to remember a strong master password, it generates one and combines it with a PIN to unlock the vault.
Features include generated pseudo-phrase passwords, labels, expiring credentials, pinned entries, Android vault import/export, and a Secret Service backed keystore on Linux.
